title: A Multistakeholder Approach Towards Evaluating Al Transparency Mechanisms
reasoning: The paper focuses on designing a study to evaluate AI transparency mechanisms. While it mentions ethics as a potential area of concern that transparency can help address (e.g., under 'Model auditing'), its primary goal is not to evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or faith. The core contribution is a methodology for assessing transparency tools, not a moral or ethical evaluation of AI systems.
